content.value: Creature combat and generated treasure supply Runic Tomes and equipment-upgrade materials. Choose a source for the reward you need instead of assuming every creature shares the same drops.

Common hostile creatures such as [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombies]], [[mob/minecraft:skeleton|Skeletons]] and [[mob/minecraft:spider|Spiders]] use an early reward pool. Stronger threats such as Witches, [[mob/minecraft:breeze|Breezes]] and [[mob/minecraft:guardian|Guardians]] use a richer pool. Apex enemies such as [[mob/minecraft:ravager|Ravagers]], [[mob/minecraft:evoker|Evokers]], [[mob/minecraft:warden|Wardens]] and [[mob/minecraft:elder_guardian|Elder Guardians]] use another. Tome rewards require player combat kills; passive livestock are not a source of ordinary combat tomes.

Open a specialized tome article to see its actual creature sources. Themes are not a substitute for checking the source: a cold-looking animal is not automatically eligible to drop an [[item/cranks-dungeons:cold_tome|Ice]] tome.

Examples include [[mob/minecraft:stray|Strays]] for [[item/cranks-dungeons:cold_tome|Ice]], [[mob/minecraft:spider|Spiders]] for Haste, [[mob/minecraft:husk|Husks]] for Body, and [[mob/minecraft:guardian|Guardians]] or [[mob/minecraft:breeze|Breezes]] for Electricity. The relevant creature and tome articles link in both directions.

[[item/cranks-dungeons:armourers_scrap|Armourer's Scrap]] improves supported armour quality. [[item/cranks-dungeons:blacksmiths_whetstone|Blacksmith's Whetstone]] improves supported weapon quality. Armoured and weapon-wielding creatures favour the corresponding material. [[item/cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil|Deepslate Sigils]] come from suitable cave, trial and elite rewards and expand supported enchantment capacity.

Mineshafts, dungeons, temples, shipwrecks, buried treasure, Trial Chambers and other generated structures offer different treasure opportunities. A Mineshaft chest cart is a useful early source of a Transmutation tome. Prepare food, carrying space and recovery before a long expedition.

Material Yield increases eligible ordinary materials. Item Rarity favours suitable higher-quality weighted results. Neither means that every listed reward is guaranteed, and neither removes the conditions for a player-kill drop. A reliable, reachable source can be more useful than a dangerous source with a richer pool.
